name: Spin N Win
author: Addicting Games
description: Spin N Win is an online casino game that has several modes to play! You don’t have to empty out your pockets for this online game, it’s all in good fun. There are several mini-games to play within sessions of spinning the wheel. Find games like wack a’ mole, slots, scratchers, and even hangman! The main goal of this game is to spin the wheel and hope lady luck is on your side. If you have an unlucky day, just try a different mode to play a different round. There are three game modes for you to choose from Quick Cash, Marathon, and Fortune. Select Quick Cash for a quick spin of the wheel and some in-between games. Marathon is a game of 50 spins. While Fortune is dependent on the least amount of spins to earn a specific goal. No money is needed for this simple casino game that has loads of options for you to choose from.
